manifest_meta.purpose: Code map for AI agents. Consult before editing; update in the same change whenever files, features, data flows, modes, preferences, assets, native code, or build config change (see AGENTS.md).

project.name: Camera
project.license: GPL-3.0-or-later (LICENSE at repo root, verbatim gnu.org text). Dependencies must be GPLv3-compatible (Apache-2.0 OK).
project.distribution_goal: F-Droid. No Google Play Services, no proprietary/telemetry libraries, no network access. Do NOT add com.google.* (other than AndroidX transitive annotations), Firebase, MediaPipe, TensorFlow/LiteRT, ML Kit, OkHttp/Coil, or prebuilt binaries checked into the repo.
project.architecture_pattern: Single-module MVVM: Compose UI -> CameraViewModel (StateFlow) -> CaptureEngine interface (HybridCaptureEngine routing to CameraXProvider / Camera2Provider) + repositories. Manual DI in MainActivity.onCreate (Hilt is NOT wired; core/di/CameraModule.kt is fully commented out).

tech_stack.ui_framework: Jetpack Compose + Material 3, no navigation library; two Activities. Theming in ui/theme/Theme.kt: CameraAppTheme (dynamic Material You colours + system light/dark; fixed fallback palette in previews) and ViewfinderTheme (always dark, dynamic accent) used by MainActivity. Use MaterialTheme.colorScheme / CameraAccent / OnCameraAccent / ControlBackground (composable getters in CameraComponents.kt) instead of hard-coded colours. XML: Theme.Camera (android:Theme.DeviceDefault.DayNight, no action bar) for SettingsActivity; Theme.Camera.Viewfinder (black window, light bar icons) for MainActivity. MainActivity forces SystemBarStyle.dark; SettingsActivity uses auto. No Material Components library.
tech_stack.camera: CameraX 1.3.1 (core, camera2 interop, lifecycle, video, view, extensions) and raw Camera2 for Night/HDR/RAW bursts and high-speed video
tech_stack.vision: OpenCV 4.12.0 from Maven Central (org.opencv:opencv, Apache-2.0) consumed via prefab (OpenCV::opencv_java4). Only symbols exported by libopencv_java4.so are usable: core/imgproc/photo/features2d/calib3d etc. The cv::detail stitching internals are NOT exported. Face detection uses the framework android.media.FaceDetector.
tech_stack.gpu: OpenGL ES 3 via EGL14 with GLSL shaders in assets/shaders (pixel binning only)
tech_stack.image_loading: ContentResolver.loadThumbnail (MediaThumbnail composable in MainActivity.kt); no image-loading library
tech_stack.async: Kotlin Coroutines & StateFlow; Camera2 uses a HandlerThread; analyzers use ExecutorServices
tech_stack.build: AGP 8.7.3, compileSdk/targetSdk 35, minSdk 31, version catalog gradle/libs.versions.toml, release R8 minify + shrinkResources enabled (app/proguard-rules.pro keeps NativePanoramaBridge/NativeVisionBridge for JNI), buildConfig + prefab enabled, dependenciesInfo excluded from APK/AAB, optional -PabiFilter=<abi> per-ABI build

data_flow_pattern.description: Unidirectional data flow. UI events call CameraViewModel methods; ViewModel drives CaptureEngine and repositories and emits CameraUiState plus side flows; Compose collects them.

layers.ui: MainActivity.kt (CameraScreen and all main-screen composables, MediaThumbnail) + ui/camera/* overlays + ui/settings/SettingsSheet.kt + SettingsActivity.kt
layers.viewmodel: ui/camera/CameraViewModel.kt (also a SensorEventListener for tilt/yaw/pitch/orientation, registered in onResume and removed in onPause). Exposes uiState, tiltState, gestureState, orientationState, focusState, autoShowLeveler. Capabilities/zoom presets refresh in onCameraReady() (engine callback).
layers.engine: data/engine/CaptureEngine.kt interface -> HybridCaptureEngine.kt routes per CameraMode to CameraXProvider.kt or Camera2Provider.kt
layers.processing: data/engine/processing/* (ImageProcessor facade, GpuImageProcessor binning, NightStacker, PortraitSegmenter, FaceLocator, NativeVisionBridge, NativePanoramaBridge, PanoramaSession, PanoramaFrameAnalyzer)
layers.repository: data/repository/UserPreferencesRepository.kt (DataStore), MediaRepository.kt (latest MediaStore URI + thumbnails), MediaSaver.kt (all processed JPEG writes + MediaStore value builders), DeviceLocationProvider.kt (geotag source)
layers.domain: domain/model/* enums and data classes shared across layers

data_flow_pattern.preferences_flow: UserPreferencesRepository.userPreferencesFlow -> CameraViewModel.observePreferences() -> CameraUiState.userPreferences and captureEngine.applySettings(prefs) / setFlashMode(prefs.effectiveFlashMode) / setGestureTriggerEnabled. SettingsActivity writes to the repository directly (no ViewModel).
data_flow_pattern.capture_output: Providers save to MediaStore DCIM/Camera themselves (processed bitmaps via MediaSaver.saveJpeg with IS_PENDING + EXIF/GPS; CameraX file captures via MediaSaver.newPhotoValues/newVideoValues with ImageCapture.Metadata.location) and return a URI string via onSuccess; ViewModel then updates lastCapturedUri / refreshThumbnail().
data_flow_pattern.rotation: UI is portrait-locked. MainActivity's OrientationEventListener -> CameraViewModel.setDeviceRotation -> CaptureEngine.setTargetRotation (Surface.ROTATION_*). CameraXProvider applies it to ImageCapture/VideoCapture; Camera2Provider.outputRotation() uses it for JPEG_ORIENTATION, bitmap rotation, DNG orientation and MediaRecorder hint.
data_flow_pattern.geotagging: MainActivity.observeLocationSetting() starts/stops DeviceLocationProvider while RESUMED and requests location permission when the pref is enabled (denial turns the pref off). Providers receive a `() -> Location?` lambda (null unless locationTagging is on).

core_entry_points.main_activity: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/camera/MainActivity.kt (manual object graph: ImageProcessor, MediaSaver, DeviceLocationProvider, CameraXProvider, Camera2Provider, HybridCaptureEngine, repositories, CameraViewModel; requests CAMERA+RECORD_AUDIO; orientation listener; volume-key shutter; secure lock-screen camera via STILL_IMAGE_CAMERA[_SECURE]; finishes onStop when secure)
core_entry_points.settings_activity: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/camera/SettingsActivity.kt (only functional settings + About; toggles mapped by key in onToggle)
core_entry_points.android_manifest: app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml (CAMERA, RECORD_AUDIO, ACCESS_COARSE/FINE_LOCATION; no INTERNET; both activities portrait-locked)

camera_modes.enum: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/camera/domain/model/CameraMode.kt (PHOTO, VIDEO, NIGHT_SIGHT, HDR, SLOW_MO, PORTRAIT, PANORAMA, LONG_EXPOSURE, TIME_LAPSE)
camera_modes.ui_mode_lists: Single source: CameraModes object in CameraMode.kt. photo = [NIGHT_SIGHT, PORTRAIT, PHOTO, LONG_EXPOSURE, PANORAMA], video = [SLOW_MO, TIME_LAPSE, VIDEO]; CameraModes.label() (NIGHT_SIGHT shown as "Night"), isVideo(), isCamera2Video(). HDR is NOT in a row: it is the hdrPhoto preference applied to PHOTO. MainActivity (onModeSwiped, CameraControls, CameraModeSelector) reads CameraModes. When adding a mode: CameraMode + CameraModes lists/label + HybridCaptureEngine/provider routing.

routing.LONG_EXPOSURE: HybridCaptureEngine unbinds CameraX -> Camera2Provider.captureStack(StackKind.LONG_EXPOSURE): warm-up, 16-frame YUV burst at metered exposure (AE lock), NightStacker align+average without tone map -> MediaSaver (LONG_) -> restore
routing.TIME_LAPSE: HybridCaptureEngine unbinds CameraX -> Camera2Provider.setupTimeLapseRecording: regular session + MediaRecorder (setCaptureRate 2 fps, encoded 30 fps, <=1080p 16:9, stabilization on) writing to pending MediaStore FD; stop shares stopSlowMoVideo; no live preview while recording (overlay text shown).
routing.PHOTO_HDR: PHOTO with prefs.hdrPhoto on the rear camera routes to Camera2Provider.captureHdr (RAW_JPEG takes precedence -> captureStill).
routing.PHOTO: Default: CameraXProvider.capturePhoto -> captureBinnedPhoto (MP_12 + back camera, GPU binning, saved via MediaSaver) else captureSinglePhoto. If saveMode == RAW_JPEG on the back camera: HybridCaptureEngine unbinds CameraX -> Camera2Provider.captureStill (JPEG bytes + DNG via DngCreator) -> CameraXProvider.restore().
routing.PORTRAIT: CameraXProvider.capturePortrait -> in-memory capture (captureUprightBitmap) -> ImageProcessor.processPortrait -> PortraitSegmenter (FaceLocator + NativeVisionBridge.nativePortraitBokeh) -> MediaSaver
routing.PANORAMA: Shutter toggles CameraViewModel.handlePanoramaCapture -> CaptureEngine.startPanorama / stopPanorama (CameraXProvider only; Camera2Provider rejects). ImageAnalysis (RGBA, 4:3, ~1600x1200) -> PanoramaFrameAnalyzer -> PanoramaSession -> native PanoramaEngine. Progress via CaptureEngine.setOnPanoramaProgressListener -> CameraUiState.panoramaProgress -> PanoramaGuideOverlay; hint COMPLETE triggers stopPanoramaCapture. A second sweep is refused while one is still stitching. See feature_map.panorama.
routing.NIGHT_SIGHT: HybridCaptureEngine unbinds CameraX -> Camera2Provider.captureNight: warm-up repeating request on an offscreen SurfaceTexture until AE/AF settle, then 8-frame YUV burst (manual exposure: 2x metered time capped at 100ms, ISO compensated x1.3; AE-lock fallback) -> NightStacker (native align+average+tone map) -> MediaSaver -> CameraXProvider.restore()
routing.HDR: HybridCaptureEngine unbinds CameraX -> Camera2Provider.captureHdr: warm-up, then manual -2/0/+2 EV JPEG bracket (<=8.4MP; AE-compensation fallback) -> ImageProcessor.fuseHdrFrames (native MTB + Mertens) -> rotate -> MediaSaver -> CameraXProvider.restore()
routing.VIDEO: CameraXProvider.startRecording via startSlowMoVideo/stopSlowMoVideo (names are historical); audio enabled when RECORD_AUDIO granted; VideoCapture bound only in VIDEO/SLOW_MO. QuickTake in PHOTO/PORTRAIT temporarily sets engine mode VIDEO and starts recording in CameraViewModel.onCameraReady().
routing.SLOW_MO: HybridCaptureEngine unbinds CameraX -> Camera2Provider.setupHighSpeedRecording (constrained high-speed session + MediaRecorder writing to a pending MediaStore FD; capture rate = high fps, encoded at 30 fps) -> stop restores CameraX. No live preview while recording.

camera_modes.pro_mode: CameraUiState.isProMode (toggled by the bottom-right Tune button) shows ProControlOverlay; ProConfig applied live via CameraXProvider.applyProConfigLive (Camera2CameraControl options; AE off when ISO/shutter set, manual focus, AWB preset) and Camera2Provider.applyProConfig for Camera2 stills
camera_modes.scene_analysis: CameraXProvider.attachSceneMonitor: Preview Camera2Interop session capture callback computes ISO*seconds every 15 frames with hysteresis (enter 40, exit 20) -> setOnLowLightListener (PHOTO, rear, prefs.lowLightSuggestion) -> CameraUiState.lowLightSuggested -> SuggestionChips. Same hook pins CONTROL_AE_TARGET_FPS_RANGE for VIDEO when prefs.videoFrameRate is supported. QR: data/engine/analysis/FrameAnalysisRouter.kt fans ImageAnalysis frames to GestureAnalyzer.processFrame and QrCodeAnalyzer (NativeVisionBridge.nativeDecodeQr, OpenCV QRCodeDetector) in PHOTO when prefs.scanQrCodes -> setOnQrCodeListener -> CameraUiState.qrCode -> SuggestionChips/openQrPayload (links/tel/mailto/geo/sms open externally, else copy). CameraXProvider.setMode rebinds on every mode change.
camera_modes.exposure_and_capture_options: CaptureEngine.setExposureCompensation(index) (all three engines; Camera2 applies it in applyCommon so warm-up metering includes it). CameraXProvider.applyFocusAndStabilization adds AF_MODE_MACRO (macroFocus ON, rear) to Preview/ImageCapture and CONTROL_VIDEO_STABILIZATION_MODE to Preview in VIDEO/SLOW_MO. Recorder QualitySelector follows videoResolution (FHD/UHD with fallback). Rebind on resolution/aspect/videoResolution/videoStabilization/macroFocus changes. Torch in video when lightMode == FLASH (CameraViewModel.applyTorch).

main_camera_screen.description: Preview (PreviewView in AndroidView), top bar (12MP/MAX chip, flash cycle Off/Auto/On, timer and macro chips), tap-to-focus with brightness slider, shutter with long-press QuickTake, zoom presets with live value, centred mode carousel, photo/video toggle, settings button, manual-controls (Tune) button, full-screen processing overlay only for Night/HDR/Portrait (thumbnail spinner otherwise), timer/panorama/status-message overlays, platform thumbnail opening the last capture, permission screen.
main_camera_screen.key_composables: MainActivity.kt: CameraScreen, CameraPreview (viewfinder anchored below TopBarHeight for 4:3/16:9; tap=focus, double-tap=flip, pinch=zoom, horizontal swipe=mode; hosts ExposureSlider), CameraControls, CameraModeSelector (centred carousel), PhotoVideoToggle, ZoomSwitcher (live zoom label), RotatableIcon, TimerCountdownOverlay, MediaThumbnail, CameraLayoutPreview (@Preview layout check). ui/camera/PanoramaOverlay.kt (matches Google Camera's panorama UI from user reference screenshots): PanoramaViewfinderGuide, drawn inside the viewfinder via CameraPreview's viewfinderOverlay slot (hollow target circle, short yellow horizon either side, white triangle arrow on the line in the pan direction, white 'next dot' positioned from keyframeDx/targetStep/verticalOffset; circle+dot turn yellow while aligned; idle shows a centre dot, arrows on both sides (either direction until the first movement) and the 'Tap shutter and pause briefly on dots' pill; during a sweep only SLOW_DOWN/LOST appear as text; previews: Sweeping/Aligned/Idle), PanoramaStrip (top-corner preview, 112dp tall: live thumbnail before the sweep, then the growing mosaic incl. the live view; right corner for leftward/unknown sweeps, left for rightward), PanoramaShutterGlyph (idle shutter icon). While isPanoramaCapturing, CameraControls fades out everything but the shutter (dark disc + white rounded stop square, no ring) and the top bar is hidden; QuickTake long-press is disabled in Panorama. ui/camera/CameraComponents.kt: CameraTopBar (resolution chip, flash cycle, timer/macro chips), ExposureSlider, RotatingIconButton, PermissionRequiredScreen, formatZoom, TopBarHeight, CameraAccent.

hud_overlay.description: Grid (3x3, 4x4, golden ratio), horizon leveler, focus ring, hand/face detection boxes.

pro_controls.description: ProControlPanel below the top bar: logarithmic ISO/shutter (only when MANUAL_SENSOR), focus in diopters, WB presets (mapped to CONTROL_AWB_MODE presets), per-control Auto chips, Reset. Applied live via Camera2CameraControl.setCaptureRequestOptions in CameraXProvider.applyProConfigLive (no rebind).

quick_settings_sheet.description: In-camera bottom sheet (SettingsSheetContent is previewable). General tab: PhotoSettings (flash, timer Off/3/10 via TimerMode.selectable, ratio, macro) or VideoSettings (1080p/4K, torch, frame rate, stabilization). More tab: photo = HDR, resolution, file format; video = record audio; both = grid (cycles), leveler, location. Top Shot / Motion Photo / Lens Selection are not implemented and not shown.

full_settings.description: SettingsActivity sections: General (save location, sounds, device storage, scan QR), Composition (framing hints, grid dialog, keep selfies as seen), Fast access (volume key action dialog, double-tap switch, palm timer), Photo (HDR, low-light suggestions), Video (resolution, frame rate dialogs, stabilization, record audio), Advanced (timer light), About (version via PackageManager, FOSS, license). SettingsList(prefs, SettingsActions) is previewable; onToggle keys: location, leveler, camera_sounds, mirror_selfies, timer_light, palm_timer, scan_qr, double_tap, low_light, hdr, stabilization, audio.

user_preferences.description: Single UserPreferences data class + enums (UserPreferences.effectiveFlashMode derives flash from LightMode). Adding a preference requires: field in UserPreferences.kt, key in UserPreferencesRepository.PreferencesKeys, mapping in userPreferencesFlow, an update* function, a CameraViewModel update/toggle method, and UI wiring. Defaults: lightMode NONE (flash off), gestureTrigger false, videoStabilization true, hdrPhoto false, videoFrameRate AUTO, recordAudio true, volumeKeyAction SHUTTER (migrated from legacy volume_key_shutter=false -> VOLUME), scanQrCodes true, doubleTapSwitch true, lowLightSuggestion true. Enum reads use enumOr() so unknown stored values fall back safely.

capture_engine.description: Engine abstraction and the hybrid router. CameraXProvider handles preview, standard/binned/portrait photos, video (with audio), panorama, palm-timer analysis, sounds, focus, target rotation, camera-ready callback, restore(). Camera2Provider handles Night/HDR bursts, RAW+JPEG stills, slow-mo high-speed video; opens the device on demand and guarantees a single completion callback (20s timeout). HybridCaptureEngine unbinds CameraX before any Camera2 operation and calls CameraXProvider.restore() afterwards; delivers callbacks on the main thread.
capture_engine.rule: New engine capabilities must be added to the CaptureEngine interface and implemented in HybridCaptureEngine, CameraXProvider, and Camera2Provider.

image_processing.description: ImageProcessor is the facade (shader loading, pixel binning, createNightStacker, fuseHdrFrames, processPortrait). GpuImageProcessor owns the EGL context and binning programs (never release() it while ImageProcessor is in use). NightStacker streams YUV frames into the native accumulator.

portrait_segmentation.description: No ML runtime. FaceLocator (android.media.FaceDetector) -> NativeVisionBridge.nativePortraitBokeh: GrabCut seeded from the face (or a centered rect), morphology + connected components, feathered alpha, normalized-convolution background blur blended at full res in place.

panorama.description: Sweep panorama driven entirely by image tracking (no sensor dots). Capture: CameraXProvider binds a 4:3 RGBA ImageAnalysis (target 1600x1200) in PANORAMA; startPanorama creates a PanoramaSession (tan(FOV/2) from LENS_INFO_AVAILABLE_FOCAL_LENGTHS + SENSOR_INFO_PHYSICAL_SIZE / zoom) and locks AE/AWB via applyProConfigLive. PanoramaFrameAnalyzer feeds every frame synchronously to the native PanoramaEngine: frame projected to a cylinder at ~300px width, tracked against the last keyframe (ORB + 1-point translation RANSAC, phaseCorrelate fallback), 'pause on dots' keyframing: the next dot sits 33% of the width past the last keyframe on the starting horizon, and a keyframe is taken only when the dot is inside the target circle (4.5% of width) and the camera has been paused (smoothed speed < 0.12 widths/s, from ImageProxy timestamps passed to nativeProcessFrame) for 400 ms. There is no forced capture: panning past a dot captures nothing, the UI arrow flips back toward the dot and a 'Go back to the dot' pill appears; the native preview strip also draws the live view (PanoramaSession double-buffers it at ~15 Hz); before a sweep PanoramaFrameAnalyzer emits an idle live thumbnail (NativePanoramaBridge.nativeThumbnail, ~8 Hz) as PanoramaProgress(isIdlePreview = true); live focal self-calibration (homography-cleaned planar matches vs keyframe 0, 1-D cylinder-translation fit) rebuilds the tracking cylinder if lens metadata is wrong. Status/hints (START, KEEP_GOING, SLOW_DOWN, TILT_UP/DOWN, LOST, COMPLETE) + a 360-degree preview strip reach the UI as PanoramaProgress (~15 Hz). COMPLETE (360 degrees or 48 keyframes) auto-stops. Stitch (stopPanorama detaches the session on the analysis executor, then Dispatchers.Default): focal re-fit over all pairs, full-res cylindrical warp, pairwise ORB refinement at half res, vertical drift levelling, per-seam gain match, DP min-cost seam + local Laplacian multi-band blend, crop to largest covered rectangle -> exact-size Bitmap -> MediaSaver (PANO_). Fewer than 2 keyframes -> PanoramaTooShortException ('Pan further...'). Host-verifiable: PanoramaEngine.cpp only needs OpenCV core/imgproc/features2d/calib3d + android/log.h.
panorama.rule: JNI names are bound to com.fearmikey.camera.data.engine.processing.NativePanoramaBridge (panorama_jni.cpp) and com.fearmikey.camera.data.engine.processing.NativeVisionBridge (vision_jni.cpp); renaming/moving those classes requires updating the C++ symbol names. Do not use cv::detail stitching classes (not exported by the Maven OpenCV .so).

gesture_palm_timer.description: CameraX ImageAnalysis (RGBA, 640x480) bound when gestureTrigger is enabled (not in PANORAMA). GestureAnalyzer: every 3rd frame -> upright 320px bitmap -> FaceLocator gate -> NativeVisionBridge.nativeDetectOpenPalm (face-calibrated YCrCb skin mask, face/neck removed, convexity defects >= 3 finger gaps). 3 consecutive hits trigger; 8s cooldown. ViewModel.setupGestureTrigger smooths boxes into GestureOverlayState for the HUD and starts a 3s timer.

sensors_and_orientation.description: Rotation-vector sensor in CameraViewModel drives tilt (leveler) and icon rotation (orientationState). Panorama no longer uses sensors (guidance comes from image tracking). Capture rotation comes from MainActivity's OrientationEventListener (see data_flow_pattern.rotation).

media_thumbnail.description: MediaRepository queries the newest image/video in MediaStore (off the main thread); MediaThumbnail renders it with ContentResolver.loadThumbnail; tapping opens ACTION_VIEW on that URI with its MIME type and read-grant.

media_saving_and_location.description: MediaSaver writes processed JPEGs (pending insert, EXIF date/make/model/GPS) and builds MediaStore ContentValues for CameraX photo/video outputs. DeviceLocationProvider wraps the framework LocationManager (fused/gps/network) while resumed.

resources.strings: app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml (most UI text is hard-coded in composables, not in strings.xml)
resources.themes: app/src/main/res/values/themes.xml (Theme.Camera DayNight + Theme.Camera.Viewfinder). values-night removed (DayNight parent handles it).
resources.icons: app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_camera_modern.xml, ic_launcher_foreground.xml, ic_launcher_background.xml, ic_launcher_monochrome.xml (themed-icon silhouette, lens cut out), mipmap-* (adaptive icons reference the monochrome layer)
resources.assets: Only GLSL shaders under app/src/main/assets/shaders. No ML model files.

docs.changelog: CHANGELOG.md (## [X.Y.Z] - YYYY-MM-DD sections with Added/Improved/Fixed; current work under ## [Unreleased])

known_gaps_and_stubs: No LICENSE file yet: required for F-Droid (project owner must choose a license, e.g. GPL-3.0-or-later or Apache-2.0).
No DI framework: object graph is built in MainActivity.onCreate; CameraViewModel is constructed directly (not via ViewModelProvider), so it does not survive configuration changes.
Slow motion and Time lapse show no live preview while recording (Camera2 cannot render into the CameraX PreviewView); an overlay explains this.
New modes/features (Long exposure, Time lapse, QR, low-light chip, fps pinning, volume zoom) are build- and preview-verified only, not device-tested.
Video snapshot is unavailable during slow-motion recording.
Top Shot, Motion Photo, Lens Selection, Ultra HDR, imageFormat (HEIF) and videoCodec preferences exist but are not implemented (hidden from UI).
White balance uses AWB presets, not true Kelvin control.
Layout verified only via @Preview renders (CameraLayoutPreview, sheet and panel previews), not yet on a physical device.
Palm timer requires a visible face and relies on a skin-colour model; less robust than an ML hand tracker.
Universal APK is large (~200MB debug) because OpenCV ships 4 ABIs; use -PabiFilter for per-ABI builds.
Night/HDR process at <=12.6MP / <=8.4MP respectively; HDR Mertens fusion is memory-heavy.

Panorama: portrait-held horizontal sweeps only; output height = analysis stream long side (~1600px, 1280 on the emulator); keyframes are kept in native memory (~5.8MB each, max 48). Translation-only model, so strong camera roll or close parallax can ghost (seams usually hide it). Not yet tested on a physical device; the emulator virtual scene cannot be panned from adb, so stitching was verified with a host harness (synthetic pinhole sweeps with drift/noise and wrong lens metadata) plus on-emulator start/stop/HUD and one mouse-panned sweep.
A stray .artifacts/ directory exists under app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/camera/ (git-ignored planning docs, not code).
